subject: [PATCH 03/22] mm: introduce the common-memory node state

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch introduces the concept of 'common memory' in Linux, which refers to memory that can be managed by the kernel's MM services without needing explicit node requests. It adds a new node state called N_MEMORY_COMMON and exposes this information through sysfs attributes. The patch also updates documentation and APIs to reflect these changes, allowing userspace to identify nodes with common memory available for ordinary allocations.
